diagnosis: The endpoint reads session telemetry directly from Redis by sessionId. It verifies authentication via requireAuthHeader, but never checks if the session data's userId matches req.user.id. An attacker can inspect sessions of other users to obtain IP addresses, user agents, and security states.
exploit_request:
GET /api/sessions/s_corporate_exec_4412/details HTTP/1.1
Host: security.mycompany.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
